desc: Filter nums to keep only elements <= threshold, as any element > threshold cannot form an edge (LCM >= element > threshold).
Create a boolean array `present` of size `threshold + 1` to mark which numbers are in the filtered list.
Initialize Union-Find structure for the numbers in the filtered list.
Iterate through each number `L` from 1 to `threshold`.
For each `L`, find all its divisors.
For each divisor `d` of `L` that is present in the set, union `d` with the first found divisor for `L` (or `L` itself if present) to connect all divisors of `L`.
Finally, count the number of unique roots in the Union-Find structure for all elements in the filtered list.
Add the count of numbers originally $> \text{threshold}$ (each forms its own component) to the result.
